title: Release Notes (Module 10 — Release Notes Generator output)
description: Produced by diffing this run's plan + analysis against the previous archived run for the same feature in history_dir. The four buckets are the master plan's; `compared_against` and `evidence` are additions, because a release note nobody can trace back to a step is a release note nobody can check.

compared_against.description: The previous archive id (a history_dir subdirectory name), or the literal 'none' for a first run.

breaking_changes.description: Changed selector/route/expected_result on a step that already existed. Flagged, never assumed intentional — a renamed selector and a regression look identical from here.

step_id.description: The step this claim came from, so a reader can open the run log and check it.

evidence.description: What in the artifacts supports this — a status change, a selector diff, a persisting risk_note.
